settings.ceo_bio:
For twenty years, DADO has been shaping the culture of ceramics in Uzbekistan. To us, tile is not merely a building material but a foundation that gives a space its character and keeps its appearance for years. The ROMA, ITALICA and GRESART brands were created with exactly this outlook.

The trust of our clients is our greatest value. We approach every order with care, from quality control to delivery and follow-up advice. We look forward to welcoming you to the DADO showroom and finding the right solution for your home or project together.
settings.ceo_bio_uz:
Yigirma yil davomida DADO O‘zbekistonda keramika madaniyatini shakllantirib kelmoqda. Biz uchun plitka shunchaki qurilish materiali emas, balki makonga xarakter beradigan, yillar davomida o‘z ko‘rinishini saqlaydigan asosdir. ROMA, ITALICA va GRESART brendlari aynan shu qarash asosida yaratilgan.

Mijozlarimizning ishonchi bizning eng katta qadriyatimizdir. Biz har bir buyurtmaga mas’uliyat bilan yondashamiz: sifat nazoratidan tortib, yetkazib berish va keyingi maslahatgacha. Sizni DADO showroomida ko‘rishdan va uyingiz yoki loyihangiz uchun eng to‘g‘ri yechimni birga topishdan mamnun bo‘lamiz.

Доверие наших клиентов — наша главная ценность. Мы ответственно подходим к каждому заказу: от контроля качества до доставки и последующих консультаций. Будем рады видеть вас в шоуруме DADO и вместе подобрать наиболее подходящее решение для вашего дома или проекта.

brand.hero_subtitle: Concrete, terrazzo and wood textures in calm, precise and durable ceramics.
brand.about_text:
ITALICA collections speak the language of contemporary architecture: straight lines, large planes, a restrained palette. Concrete and terrazzo textures suit lofts, offices and public spaces, while wood-look tiles bring warmth to residential interiors. Each collection comes in complementary wall and floor formats.

We pay particular attention to the practical qualities of the surface: matt and structured finishes resist slipping, clean easily and withstand daily wear. Large format reduces the number of joints and makes a room feel wider. ITALICA is a choice that stays relevant for years.

history.title: The birth of ITALICA
history.text: DADO introduced a separate brand for contemporary interiors, ITALICA. The first collections came out in concrete texture in the 600×600 format.

history.title: Moving to large format
history.text: The 600×1200 and 800×1600 formats joined the brand's range, giving architects the means to create continuous surfaces with minimal joints.

history.title: Terrazzo and wood collections
history.text: ITALICA opened new lines in terrazzo and wood looks. The brand now offers the three key textures of the contemporary interior in a single consistent style.

news.title: Partnership programme for designers and architects
news.excerpt: DADO launches a partnership programme for interior designers and architects: a sample library, project consultations and the option to meet clients in the showroom.

news.title: ITALICA: concrete and terrazzo in 600×1200 and 800×1600 formats
news.excerpt: The new ITALICA collection is devoted to large format: 600×1200 and 800×1600 slabs with concrete and terrazzo looks. We explain why large format is the designers' choice today.

news.title: Interior trends 2026: what tile has to offer
news.excerpt: Natural textures, calm colours and large formats are the main directions in interior design for 2026. How to find them in the ROMA, ITALICA and GRESART collections.

news.title: Choosing tiles for a bathroom: what to look for
news.excerpt: A bathroom is where humidity, temperature changes and daily use come together. Practical advice on choosing surface, format and colour.
